reason: The orthorhombic 8.57773 x 8.45681 x 6.34111 A cell is strongly indexed and Z=2 plus the Te/S/Fe average framework are plausible, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied, and the reported approximately 9.5-10.3% custom-profile Rwp values do not constitute an independently comparable refinement. The P21212 choice and especially the Li coordinates/order remain underdetermined: only a narrow set of constrained Pmmn/P21212 parameterizations was instantiated, independent starts did not all reach the same basin, and the diffraction-only polish improved the fit only by developing severe contact violations. The submitted primary still has a short 1.926 A Li-Fe contact, while the chemically cleaner Pmmn model fits somewhat worse, so fit and plausibility are in tension. Moreover, alternative-1.cif is described as Pmmn but declares P 21 21 2 operations/IT number 18, despite only being detected as Pmmn from its special coordinates. Thus the data support the cell and heavy-atom average much more strongly than the submitted symmetry, exact coordinates, and Li ordering; another attempt should test materially distinct ordering/symmetry realizations with a standard whole-pattern refinement and chemical validation.
